properties.name: Perun vs Veles
properties.summary: The thunder god Perun eternally battles the chthonic serpent-god Veles, who steals cattle, water, or Perun's wife from the heavens. Perun hurls lightning to strike Veles, who hides in trees, animals, or water. The cycle of theft and retribution mirrors the seasonal cycle and the cosmic order.

properties.name: Baba Yaga and Vasilisa
properties.summary: Orphaned Vasilisa was sent by her stepmother to fetch fire from Baba Yaga, the fearsome witch who lives in a hut on chicken legs, surrounded by a fence of bones. Using her dead mother's magical doll for guidance, Vasilisa completed impossible tasks and obtained fire that burned her cruel stepfamily.

properties.name: Rod Creates the Universe
properties.summary: Rod, the supreme creator, broke the cosmic egg to create the universe. Light and darkness, earth and sky separated. He created Svarog the sky-smith who forged the sun. The Rozhanitsy (Rod's daughters) wove the fates of all living beings. Rod breathed life into everything and retired to the highest heaven.

properties.name: The Rusalki — Water Spirits
properties.summary: Rusalki are water spirits — souls of young women who died violently near water. They emerge during Rusalka Week in early summer, dancing in moonlit meadows and forests. Their beauty enchants young men, whom they lure into rivers to drown. Green wreaths and garlic protect against them.

properties.name: The Firebird (Zhar-Ptitsa)
properties.summary: Prince Ivan pursued the Firebird that was stealing golden apples. Guided by a grey wolf, he endured trials — capturing the bird, stealing a golden horse, and rescuing a princess. His jealous brothers killed him, but the wolf brought him back to life. Ivan married the princess and claimed the kingdom.
